ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited reported exceptionally strong financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, with revenue growing over 20% year-on-year and net profit more than doubling, reflecting significant margin expansion. This robust performance is primarily driven by impressive growth in both its Elevator and Stainless Steel Polishing Divisions, the latter expanding by over 70%. The company maintains a healthy growth momentum supported by strategic investments and improved operational efficiencies, with no immediate red flags identified in the reported financials.
